summary: This unit (scope LeanPool/@files/all) consists of 252 top-level LeanPool/<Name>.lean files, one per vendored project in the LeanPool aggregate repo; each is either that project's umbrella import file (re-exporting its own internal modules with a docstring naming the source URL/arXiv id, main declarations, and MSC tags) or, in three cases, a project whose sole content lives directly in this top-level file. Prior review (r1) covered a smaller snapshot and retained all files as 'mathematical project umbrellas or source-owned modules'; 252 files changed or were added and 2 were removed since. A declaration-keyword grep over the exact 252-file scope found 105 files with no theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/elab/noncomputable keyword. All 105 were read (in full for a diverse sample, and structurally verified for the rest via targeted greps -- see review_evidence) and confirmed to be pure module-import-index files: a `module` header, `public import`/`import` statements of the project's own sibling submodules plus occasional Mathlib imports, and a docstring (title, Source/Authors/Status/Main declarations/Tags/MSC fields, occasionally a longer 'Mathematical overview'/'Provenance' section) -- with zero declarations and, confirmed by a scope-wide grep, none of them containing `open`, `notation`, `attribute`, `register_simp_attr`, `macro`, `syntax`, `alias`, or `set_option` commands, which FILTER-007 would otherwise treat as taking a file outside its unilateral pure-import class. These 105 files are retained under FILTER-007, matching the precedent already applied across sources 13-17 and units 1-2 of this source. The three largest files (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.lean 259260 bytes, MulticolorTriangleRamsey.lean 129979 bytes, UnconditionalSchauderBasis.lean 56858 bytes) were sampled at their heads and are genuine, dense proof files, not aggregators. One file, LeanPool/Basic.lean (267 bytes, the unit's smallest file), was read in full and found to be a distinct case from the 105 aggregators: it has no imports at all and consists solely of `module` / `@[expose] public section` / a docstring reading 'Placeholder greeting string.' / `def hello := "world"` -- a placeholder definition holding no formal mathematical content, comparable in kind to the lakefile.lean build-configuration exclusions already applied in sources 3, 5, 9-12, 19, and 23 of this review pass (a def that constructs no mathematical fact). This file is excluded under FILTER-004 condition 1. A junk-signal grep and a TODO/FIXME grep (run as a separate command) both found 0 matches across the full 252-file scope.
